Name: Ossa the cat
Author: alex1017330
Description:
[b][u]INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS \/\/\/\/[/u][/b]

step 1: unzip this file
step 2: go to steam and click on Stardew Valley then click the cog icon, hover over 'manage' and then click 'browse local files'
step 3: go in to the 'Content' folder at the top then into the 'Animals' folder
step 4: find the file named 'cat4.xnb' and delete it (you can delete any other cat xnb just be sure to rename the new xnb file to the corresponding cat! for example if you choose to delete 'cat2.xnb' be sure to rename the xnb in the file 'ossa' to 'cat2.xnb') ((i haven't actually tested this so i'm not entirely sure this is true))
step 5: go in to the file named 'ossa' and drag and drop the 'cat4.xnb' in to the 'Animals' folder
step 6: done! now open the game and see if it worked!

thank you for downloading my mod <3

[u]FOR ANYONE WHO DOESNT UNDERSTAND:[/u] i will happily provide more detailed instructions incase i was unclear! feel free to comment here and we will figure it out :)
